tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /pho rkyang drag po'i sbyin sreg gdug can za ba'i 'jigs rung me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir pho rkyang gi drag po'i sbyin sreg bram ze mchog sred kyi gzhung dang / sa skya pa chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin gnyan phul chung bas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i gsal byed ni mi lpags sam dug shog gro shog gang rung la dug khrag snag tshas bris pa'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs phyir mu khyud nyis rim bris pa'i lte ba dang rtsibs rnams la yig 'go phyir bstan gyis/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sarba sha truṃ dī na me ke na mā ra ya/ mu khyud la shā sa na'i mthar 'di zhes bya ba mā ra ya/ zhes bkod pa dang / tsha ba gsum dang bag phye la bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan chags tshad dang ldan pa che chung ji ltar rigs pa byas pa'i rgyab nas 'khor lo shongs tshad kyi gru gsum bru/ spra tshil tsha ba gsum gyi khu bas liṅga byugs pa ni dgra la bya ba dang / bgegs la byed na g.yang gzhi'am dur khrod kyi ras la lha klu rgyal btsan sogs gnod byed gang yin de'i gzugs brnyan nyam thag pa'i snying gar ming bris pa shing glang ma rtsa rtse ma nor ba bkas pa'i srag tu mgo mjug ldog la gzhug rtsa ba rno bar byas te tshil chen gyis bgos pa'i stegs la gzugs/ bag zan la'ang de'i gzugs brnyan nyam thag par bzos/ dur khrod du 'gro ba'am ro bsregs pa'i rdo'i sgyed pu gsum la lcags slang bkal/ shing tsher ma can gru gsum du brtsigs/ dbus su rdul tshon dang 'bru nag gang rung gi tshom bu bkod/ mgon po dang me lha la drag bshos zur gsum che chung gnyis dang bdud rtsi lnga mchod bshams/ dgra bsreg pa'i rdzas khrag sna/ yungs dkar nag thang phrom pa'i 'bras bu rnams dang / bgegs bsreg pa'i rdzas dug sna yungs dkar nag ske tshe/ sgog skya/ 'byung po'i bla rdo'i phye ma rnams thod pa mtshan ngan du bshams la sbyin sreg mi byed pa'i gong zhag kha shas nas yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas dang mgon po la mchod gtor 'bul/

ling 'khor gyi rab gnas ni/ 'khor lo 'bru nag gi steng du bzhag la/ gtor ma gru gsum dang chu gnyis nyer mchod kyis bskor/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo nag po rtsibs drug pa lte ba dang rtsibs myur rnams la yig 'bru me dang dug gi 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kha nas 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang yang / mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ ma hā kā la sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo dang bcas pra tītstsha'i mtha' can gyis mchod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung / oṃ ma hā kā la sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ji ltar rigs pa/ srin gzugs ma shlauka gcig gis bstod/ dgug gzhug gi dmigs pa dang / tshig rigs mgon po'i man ngag gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar yid ches par byas la lte ba dang rtsibs kyi spel tshig rnams la bstim/ yang mchod gtor 'bul ba'am/ yang na 'khor lo dang sngags kyi 'od zer gyis spel tshig de tshar gcod par bsam/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams brgya stong ji ltar rigs pa bzlas man ngag bzhin bltab/ ro skra shan pa'i bu mos 'gal bas rgya gram du bcings la zan ling gi rgyab nas bcug ste/ zan dang spra tshil bzhu bas mi mngon par bkag la/ rang dang thab khung gi bar du dgra bgegs kyi liṅga rnams lcags snod du mgo tshur bstan la bzhag rdor dril nang mchod gri gug rnga rol sogs bshams/ sgrub pa po zhwa dang gos nag gyon la/ kha lhor phyogs pas nyin phyed dam mtshan phyed kyi dus su kyai rdor dang 'byung 'dul sogs rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas liṅga rnams la dgug gzhug lha dbye bsgral mchod rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa byas rjes dur khrod dam shan pa'i me'am rdo lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes shā sa na bzla zhing sbar la/

thab khung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i thab khung gru gsum mthing nag me ri 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ging las ra skyes chen po'i steng du raṃ las me lha dmar la nag pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gri gug dang be con/ g.yon thod pa dang ril ba 'dzin pa/ ag tshom 'phyang ba rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ drang srong gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃḥ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum/ 'jig rten dbang phyug shlau ka gcig dgra bo'i liṅga'i dum bu dang / bgegs kyi shog ling zan ling glang ma bcas kyi dum bu dang / drag po'i rdzas rnams lan gsum re phul la/ oṃ agna ye sarba sha trūṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥces dang / thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ sarba bighnān zhes dang / sarba sha trūṃ bighnān zhes sbyar/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su rin po che'i brag stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i steng du chos 'byung nag po de'ang mtshungs pa'i lte bar/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbus su sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ mgon po pho nya lnga bcas bskyed pa'i mtha' bskor du phyogs skyong bcus bskor bar bsams la/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pa'am rdor dril 'dzin pa'am/

dam rgya bcas la/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren bzhugs/ /oṃ e hya hi ma hā kā la ya a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ṭā ki ni dha ya yo gi shwa re sa mā ya satwaṃ tri shya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/ nag po khyod kyis sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa bzhin du bdag gi las ci bcol ba gyis shig de ltar ma byas na khyod nyams par gyur ta re/ oṃ badzra ṭā ki ni dha ya yo gi shwa ra sa ma ya satwaṃ tri shya hoḥ mdun bskyed kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ drag mchod byin gyis brlabs/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la nas/ stsol gyi bar brjod pa'am/ yang na sngags tsam mam/ shin tu rgyas na bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi/ khrag gi mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar bya/ srin gzugs mas bstod la btab pa bzhag shā sa na bzla bzhin pas ling dum dang drag rdzas rnams drug cu la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa phul/ spel tshig ni me lha dang 'dra bar brjod/ mthar phyi mchod nang mchod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ mgon po la shā sa na lan nyer gcig sogs/ oṃ indha dza ma sogs bsngos la mgon po dang phyogs skyong gi bstod pa bya/ mthar drag po'i las kyi dmod bcol byas la yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang tshigs bcad lhug gis bzod gsol bya/ mgon po 'khor bcas rten dang bcas pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par bltas la/ ling ro dang drag rdzas rnams tshar gsum phul/ gtor ma sha khrag tu bsams pa mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pas bsngos/ mchod bstod byas la drag po'i phrin las zhu/ bdag gi don dang sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ bdag bskyed gang byas kyi cho gas go bsgo/

dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// ༈ /yang dam pa kun dga' grags kyi dgongs pa mdos gtor dang 'brel pa'i sbyin sreg bya tshul ni/ sham gong bzhin la mdos zhag sbrel nas bsgrub na/ de ni nyin dang po'i liṅga bsgral mchod kyi thad du slebs pa dang / liṅga'i 'khor lo bsgrubs la snying khar bcug hom ling dang bstab ling gnyis char la dgug gzhug lha dbye byas la hom ling spra tshil gyis bkab nas mdos kyi 'og tu bzhag bstab ling la bsgral mchod byas/ hom ling la sbyin sreg ma ran gyi bar du dgug gzhug lha dbye bstab ling dang lhan cig byas/ sang mdos 'phen rgyu'i do nub khyad par gyi bzlog pa rdzogs nas sbyin sreg gi chas bshams la/ hom ling la dgug gzhug nas brtsam bsgral mchod rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par byas nas 'das pa'i me lha'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ mdun bskyed maṇḍal gyi drung du/ thod pa mtshan ldan 'bru nag pos bkang ba la/ mgon po'i spos sbyor gyi rengs bu'am spos ring ji ltar rigs gtsug pa bsham/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren gyi tshe las kyi rdo rjes kha ras dang lag lcib thogs/ mdun bskyed la phyag gsum btsal thod pa spos dang bcas pa/ slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis kyang kha rlangs dang dri ma ma phog par byas la spos kyi rtse mo nas btogs/ 'bru nag cung zad dang bcas me'i dbus su gtor la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa thab nang gi dam tshig pa la thim par bsam/ phyin chad gong ji lta ba bzhin la/ 'das pa'i me lha gshegs ran pa'i tshe/ thab nang gi me nas spos sbar/ thod 'bru la btsugs pa las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag gsum btsal te gtsang sbra dang ldan pas slob dpon gyi phyag nas blangs la/ mdun bskyed kyi tsham bu la spos dang me tog gtor te/

thod 'bru spos lhag ji ltar rigs bar bsdus/ tshul 'di ni gsang sngags kyi sbyin sreg mdun bskyed dang sbrel ba thams cad la bya dgos so/ /rjes chog rnams kyang gong bzhin shes par bya'o/ /'di dam pa kun grags kyis mgon po'i mdos kyi sbyin sreg dang 'brel pa zur tsam gsungs pa'i gsal byed kho na yin la/ yang lha brgyad kyi sbyin sreg byed pa shar tshe/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung rab bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gang ltar na'ang thal ba mnan pa'am rbad 'dre rbod gtong phyogs su 'thor ba gang rung bya'o/ /zhes pho rkyang drag po'i sbyin sreg yi ge rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung rnying ma rnams gsal byed du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyan mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar/ ༈ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes las grub pa'i/ /gri gug thod 'dzin gaṇḍe'i phyag mtshan can/ /gel ba'i 'dug stangs srid gsum gar gyis rol/ /brjid pa'i gzugs can khyod la bdag bstod do/ /sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin rngams pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrog /bde chen ngang las sgrub la mchog stsol zhing / /nyams pa tshar gcod rjes 'dzin bstan la dga'/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan nag po gdug pa che/ /gtum pos bgegs 'joms 'jig rten gsum sreg pa'i/ /bskal pa'i me dpung dbus gnas tshogs kyi bdag /nag po chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /hūm̐ nag po'i bka' yi nye 'khor yid ltar mgyogs/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dbang phyug brgya byin ni/ /rnam mang dpung gis bskor nas shar du bzhugs/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /de bzhin du/ mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dbang phyug gshin rje ni/ /zhes dang / lhor bzhugs/ zhes dang / chu lha ni/ nub tu/ gnod sbyin ni/ byang du/ me lha ni/ shar lhor/ srin po ni/ lho nub/ rlung lha ni/ nub byang / 'byung po ni/

byang shar/ tshangs pa ni/ steng du/ sa lha ni/ 'og tu bzhugs zhes sbyar la thams cad rdzogs nas/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /chang dang shes byed mon sran dang / /me tog spos dang byug pa dang / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga nyid kyi/ /gtor mas mgon po 'khor bcas mchod/ /sngar bcol gtang rag gnyen po 'bul/ /da bcol gsal 'debs chen por bzhes/ /bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar chad 'gal rkyen kun/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di bsgrubs/ /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lha brgyad phyogs skyong bcu dang bcas pa'i bstod pa gong 'og bsdebs/ bstod pa dang 'dod gsol gyi tshig kha yar bsnan nas sbyar ba dge/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ pho rkyang drag po'i sbyin sreg gdug can za ba'i 'jigs rung me 'od/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
